body:
## T-03 Docker packaging (local preparation)

- Pin Node 24.21.0 and pnpm 10.15.1; install with frozen lockfile.
- Build API with generated Prisma Client and runtime dependencies; build Next.js standalone web image.
- Exclude local .env and run both images as non-root node user.
- Preserve existing local Docker Compose contract for PostgreSQL and Redis.

## Evidence

- Both Docker targets build locally; API 852 MB, web 413 MB.
- Container smoke: API /health, web /, /login, and web /api/health all return HTTP 200.
- Lint, typecheck, 4 unit tests and web build pass. GitHub Actions run `36828314186` is green (3/3 jobs, 50 seconds). No image was pushed or deployed.

## Outstanding AC / review

- Staging host, registry, SSH, HTTPS and secret source have not been provided.
- T-02 required checks are configured; failing lint proof PR #2 was blocked and closed unmerged.
- Deploy after merge, health-gated traffic switch, keep-old-container behavior and under-10-minute timing remain unverified.
- Use fake data only; review migration compatibility and rollback before staging.

Review after PR #1 then #3; this PR is stacked on #3. Do not mark T-03 Done from local image evidence.
